question: Approve the ideation of worker-knows-the-team-and-asks-early to enter implementation? FO recommends approve; approving accepts that recommendation and both decisions as recommended: D1 new-work-checks-what-exists-first follows as its own task rather than merging in; D2 the workflow word budget rises by exactly 99 words, 5421 to 5520, for one Team bullet under Dispatch facts that every worker stage reads.

artifacts.summary: Design: one 99-word Team bullet in references/sd/workflow.md Dispatch facts: the worker serves the team goal, checks prior work and shared records before substantial work or a retry, asks FO early on overlap, repeated failure, missing authority or an infeasible target, returns what it checked and found, and does not message peers. Worse: every worker and README load is 99 words longer; instruction text does not prove behaviour (AC-6 ends in accept, repair or stop). Needs an ADR number at implementation.
